utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet, but I can swing by and check while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That would be helpful, Ira. If you can check, please let me know what they still need and when they’re collecting it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll stop by and ask what they still need and when they’re collecting it. I’ll let you know as soon as I’m back.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the repair drive asking for?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly tools, tape, and any spare bulbs if you’ve got them. I can swing by and pick them up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ve got some tape and maybe a spare bulb or two. You can swing by later and grab them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I’d want to double-check the timing and who’s bringing the tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, can you confirm the time and the tool list before I head over?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I was just about to head over and help out, if you still need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes please, Oren — we could really use another pair of hands. Meet me at the garage when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: You got it — I’ll come by the garage right now and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to double-check the repair drive details before we do anything. What’s the plan, and what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I think we were gathering the broken items and a quick list of what each thing needs, but I may be missing a detail; can you remind me what you already have?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I don’t have anything gathered yet, so let’s start with a quick list of the broken items and what each one needs. If you know the deadline or where to drop them off, please include that too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — how can I help with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — glad you’re here. We could really use help sorting donations and matching folks with the right repairs.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can do that — point me to the donations, and I’ll help match people up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help, Gus — what do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I could use a hammer, a screwdriver, and maybe a tape measure if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ve got a hammer and screwdriver, and I can grab a tape measure too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t tracked the repair drive yet, but I can keep an eye on where it’s happening and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal—that would help a lot. Please let me know where it’s happening as soon as you find out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll watch for it and tell you as soon as I know the location.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’ve heard a few folks are planning to bring tools and spare parts, so it’s shaping up nicely. If you’re going, I can keep an ear out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Tess — thank you. If you hear anything, let me know, and I’ll spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Quinn — I’ll do that. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything useful about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still on for the repair drive today? If so, what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, we’re still on. If you could bring gloves and a few extra boxes, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll bring gloves and some extra boxes. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m going to mention the repair drive to a few neighbors and make sure they know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’d really appreciate that. I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so any update you can pass along helps.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll check in with a few neighbors and repeat the details so everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m mapping out the repair drive now. Can you tell me which houses or fixes you want me to prioritize?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. If you can, please put the leaking roof and the broken porch step first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll put the leaking roof and broken porch step at the top of the list. I’ll keep you posted as I line up the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely — folks have really been pitching in. I can check around and pass along the latest if you want.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be much appreciated, Tess. Please let me know the latest, and I’ll keep to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll ask around and bring you the latest as soon as I hear it. For now, it sounds like we’re still on track and people are helping out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I’m still waiting on the final details, but I’ll let everyone know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — please do. I’m happy to help once the details come through.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. What needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. It’s mostly the loose porch step and the flickering hallway light—if you could take a look, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take a look at both. I’ll stop by later today and see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — what’s the repair drive, and what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s the drive by the old maintenance shed, just past Maple Lane. I need you to drop off the spare hose and check which unit number is written on the invoice.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can drop off the spare hose and check the invoice number. I’ll swing by the old maintenance shed near Maple Lane.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can help connect folks and get the repair drive moving. What do you need from me first?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — can you send me the date, time, and location for the repair drive first? Then I can help spread the word accurately.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure — I’ll send over the date, time, and location as soon as I have them. If you want, I can also draft a quick blurb for you to share.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I must’ve missed the details; what changed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: The repair drive is still on — we’re just confirming the time and who can help with tools. I’ll send the final details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’m free to help with tools if you need me. Just send me the final time when you know it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like a good cause—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: If you’ve got a drill or a ladder to lend, that’d help a lot. Otherwise, just showing up to pitch in would be great.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can bring my ladder and stop by to help out. Just let me know what time you’re starting.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you help sort the donated tools and label the boxes? That’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donated tools and label the boxes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I need to know the timing and what still needs to be hauled before I can commit.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Pia — it starts Saturday morning, and we still need the old shelf, a broken chair, and two bags of scrap hauled off. Does that timing work for you?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Saturday morning should work for me, as long as I know about what time you’ll need me there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m telling folks about the repair drive now—want me to put your name on the list too?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, please add me to the list—I can help keep track of supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll add you now—thanks for helping keep track of supplies. I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve got the rest of the list together.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Faye — I’m not sure I’ve got the time nailed down yet, but I’ll check and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren — just send me the time when you have it, and I’ll work around the school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep the repair drive organized and make sure folks know where to bring their requests. If you’ve got anything that needs attention, send it my way and I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll pass along anything I hear. I’m still getting the updates second-hand, so I’ll let neighbors know to send their requests to you.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thanks, Nell — I’ll keep everything in one place and get it moving. Just send me anything you hear, and I’ll take it from there.
